item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - Stray Kids Fan Connecting 2024 'SKZ TOY WORLD' (1080p HD)
item.description:
Stray Kids Fan Connecting 2024 'SKZ TOY WORLD' (1080p HD)​


​
Stray Kids Fan Connecting 2024 "SKZ TOY WORLD" was Stray Kids' first-ever offline fan-meeting event held in Japan, bringing together over 160,000 fans across four major dome performances. Featured live stages of popular tracks like Butterflies, Novel, MEGAVERSE, LALALALA, and Social Path (feat. LiSA). The live shows were officially released on Blu-ray on December 24, 2025, available in both Regular and Limited Editions containing special photobooks, photocards, and behind-the-scenes footage.
​


More information: https://www.straykidsjapan.com/toyworld_bd/
